title: Line-art multi-panel storyboard
technique: One sheet of 12 line drawings sets every shot; the prompt adds only words and sound.
story: A bikini store owner gets a refund on a slow week and thinks about a discount.
Scout, a floating lime orb, freezes time before she posts it.
It takes her to a shopper who left a bikini in her cart three times.
The shopper says the store runs a discount every week, so she waits for it.
The owner deletes all her discounts. Later that week a full-price order lands.
End screen: Scout interviews your shoppers for you. Get free early access.

shots.what: A refund notification drops onto her phone
She reads the phone in her studio
shots.speaker: Owner

shots.what: Close on her, swimwear in hand
shots.line: Sales are so low this week.
shots.speaker: Owner

shots.what: Room sound drops away; her lips stay closed
shots.line: Maybe it's time for a discount.
shots.speaker: Owner (inner)

shots.what: Time freezes, camera arcs around her; the orb pops in
shots.line: Not yet. There's something you don't know.
shots.speaker: Scout

shots.what: She turns to the orb; camera flips overhead into a bedroom
The shopper packs a beach bag, the orb beside her
shots.line: You left the Sunset bikini in your cart three times. What stopped you?
shots.speaker: Scout

shots.line: You run a discount every week. I'm just waiting for it.
shots.speaker: Shopper

shots.what: Back in the studio she freezes, bikini top in hand, stunned
shots.line: Oh my god... I'm training them to wait.
shots.speaker: Owner

shots.what: From behind, she clicks Delete; a 'Discount deleted' toast appears
shots.line: You know what? Let's delete all these discounts.
shots.speaker: Owner

shots.what: Later that week, golden light; a full-price order lands
shots.speaker: Owner

shots.what: The orb becomes the 'o' of the Scout wordmark
shots.line: Scout interviews your shoppers for you. Get free early access.
shots.speaker: Scout
